verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax exposes a fully documented public REST API (Tax Calculations, Tax Transactions, Tax Registrations) with detailed parameters, response fields, and even a standalone API path for non-Stripe payment flows, letting an AI agent programmatically compute and record tax without UI interaction. This is reinforced by machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md docs) and a CLI/MCP server for programmatic access. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent hands-on confirmation of API-driven agentic workflows.
